question: The Union Cabinet approved the establishment of International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) with headquarters in India with a one-time budgetary support of ₹150 crore for a period of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5 years**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Union Cabinet approved the **International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) **with a one-time budgetary support of ₹150 crore for a period of** five years from 2023-24 to 2027-28. **
 
• The IBCA is an alliance of **96 countries that aims to conserve big cats like tigers, lions, l**eopards, snow leopards, cheetahs, jaguars, and pumas. 
 
• The IBCA's goals include **creating a global network, stopping illegal wildlife trade, and curbing poaching in Asia**. 
 
• The IBCA will use a variety of methods to achieve its goals, including knowledge-sharing, capacity-building, networking, advocacy, and financial and resource support. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Significance of protecting big cats and their habitats**

 
 
• **Balances ecosystem:** By acting as top predators in the food chain.
 
• **Water security: ** For example, the Himalayas (habitat of Snow Leopards) are the source of many major rivers in Asia. 
 
• **Mitigate Climate Change: **Protecting Forest landscapes that store carbon.
 
• **Cultural Icons:** Culturally significant with faiths and folktales built around them across the world.
 
• **Supports economy: **Providing livelihood opportunities and promoting ecotourism.
